sophia (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: partners asked for a compact rollout note for API -> Console -> Optimize. can we lock owners, short canary durations, and any doc freeze windows?

omar (CTO): high level: API -> Console -> Optimize (overlap allowed). owners: API=rita, Console=leo, Optimize=sophia. keep canaries short and staggered.

sophia (Product): can we call out exact canary lengths so partners can plan support coverage?

rita (Eng): API plan: 36h canary starting 2% traffic, expand to 12% after initial checks, then 7-day observation. deploy example: `./ci/deploy --svc api --ver 2.6.0 --canary --pct 2`. will attach smoke dashboards.

leo (DevEx): docs/SDK: avoid breaking changes. if Optimize introduces flags they must be optional. doc freeze: API docs 48h before GA; SDK minor bump allowed. I'll prepare a 20-min "what's changing" for partners day after GA.

nina (Security): telemetry policy: Private deployments default telemetry=off; public opt-out must be explicit and documented. will deliver checklist before Console canary. also request a telemetry dataflow diagram for partners.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: api-service v2.6.0 -> 2% -> 2025-03-15T16:00:00Z

sophia (Product): summary I'll publish: API canary 36h -> 7-day observation -> GA. Console parity after API GA -> 72h canary. Optimize beta rolling cohorts starting during Console stabilization; telemetry opt-out for Private. owners: rita/leo/sophia. I'll post the partner note and calendar invites when canary start is confirmed.

omar (CTO): please include runbook links and a postmortem link template for each canary ticket.

leo (DevEx): will add runbook and SDK changelog PR. posting links here shortly.
